name: chandra_flames_catalyst_minus_two_pays_with_an_untapped_mountain
notes: ENGINE FAULT (weaker than printed), fails on main fa284327. Printed: '[-2]: You may cast target red instant or sorcery card from your graveyard.' The spell cast as the -2 resolves is paid like any cast: its controller may activate mana abilities while paying (CR 601.2g, 605.3a), so an untapped Mountain pays Shock's {R}. The effect-cast lane prices and pays from the mana pool only (query._cast_option_payable and stack.cast_card call legality.build_payment_plan, which reads world.players[..].mana_pool), and the menu clamps the -2's target to cards payable from the pool (query._clamp_cast_target_slot): with the mana in a land the -2 is not offered at all. In a dealt game no mana floats (a mana ability is no menu row), so the -2 is never usable.
